evidence: The film crystallinity and grain size were analyzed by a Philips MPD 1880 powder X-ray diffractometer (XRD) using the Cu K a radiation. The film conformality was studied by a Zeiss DSM 962 scanning electron microscope (SEM). The EDX results were analyzed using a General Motors Research (GMR) electron probe thin-film microanalysis program and converted to physical thicknesses using the bulk density of TaN (16.3 g/cm³). The films deposited at 400°C contained only 4 atom % chlorine but as much as 26, 10, and 6 atom % carbon, aluminum, and hydrogen, respectively. The film deposited at 400°C had a resistivity of 1,300 mV cm. The films were polycrystalline with the cubic TaN structure.
